items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Marble? >> [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Fade Marble. [INTERVIEWEE] Fade Marble.

ctx.x: No, just with Tony Almerico. I played, you know, but a long time ago when I was 17 years old, 15, 16, 17 years old, I played on the boat, you know, two bands, they had two bands, a colored band, you know, Marble?

Fade Marble. And the extra band, uh, that, uh, it used to be that, uh, you had a club and you'd hire, you know, extra bands to play that. And then, uh, it would be continuous dancing. That's when I was a kid.
